rounds.name: Introduction
rounds.instruction: Greet the candidate and ask them to introduce themselves and their current focus.

rounds.name: Resume Deep-Dive
rounds.instruction: Ask about a specific project or experience from the resume context. Probe design decisions, trade-offs and measurable results.

rounds.name: Technical
rounds.instruction: Ask one technical question based on the question bank context, picking a topic that matches the candidate's skills. Do not repeat a topic already covered.

rounds.name: Behavioral
rounds.instruction: Ask one behavioral question (teamwork, conflict, failure or ownership).

rounds.name: Wrap-up
rounds.instruction: Ask if the candidate has any questions for the interviewer, then close politely.
